PHASE.NAME: LDD Traceability And Maintainability Polish
PHASE.GOAL: Raise release-candidate quality by closing traceability denominator gaps, adding LOG traceability evidence, and splitting the largest MCP GRACE handler file below release-risk pressure.

CONTEXT.STARTING_POINT: Post Phase-15: all gates pass, traceability score is 99.1%, traced_functions is 648/649 due duplicate function artifact identity, traced_logs is 1/6, and src/mcp/server_grace_tools.rs is 1280 lines.

step-1.TITLE: Traceability Denominator Closure
step-1.INTENT: Count function traceability by unique function artifact identity so duplicate helper names in one module do not under-report a fully traced project.
step-1.VERIFY: cargo test traceability --all-targets passed; verify --ci reports 648/648 traced functions.

step-2.TITLE: LOG Traceability Evidence
step-2.INTENT: Add explicit TRACEABILITY evidence to structured LOG fixtures and tester-agent LOG evidence so LDD signals are linked to UC/NFR intent.
step-2.VERIFY: cargo test grace::log --lib and mcp::server_grace_tools --lib passed; verify --ci reports 4/4 traced LOG markers and 100.0% traceability score.

step-3.TITLE: MCP GRACE Handler Split
step-3.INTENT: Extract suggest_contract helpers into a focused MCP helper module and reduce src/mcp/server_grace_tools.rs below the previous near-hard-limit size.
step-3.VERIFY: cargo test mcp::server_contract_tools --lib and mcp::server_grace_tools --lib passed; src/mcp/server_grace_tools.rs reduced from 1280 to 1178 lines.

step-4.TITLE: Release Candidate Gate
step-4.INTENT: Run full CI, refresh, verify, review, and release freshness gates for v2.5.2 after Phase-16 closes.
step-4.VERIFY: bash scripts/ci.sh passed with 185 tests, release/install smoke, verify --ci, review --mode full --ci, refresh --json, and status --json.

PHASE.RESUME_POINTER: Phase-16 is released as v2.5.2. Main CI run 26219487071, release workflow run 26219725566, and public-tag fresh install smoke passed.
